$comment: PLAN.md §5.6 'Temperature and layering rules — one table, one source'. Thresholds live here only. The Stage B prompt renders this file as text; the server validator and its Swift client mirror execute it by rule id. Structural rules (one_piece vs top/bottom, base_layer under a top with layer_role single|mid, shoes present, anchor) are code in both validators. Temperatures are feels-like °C over the wear window; precip is the max hourly probability in percent.

outerwear_required.text: outerwear is required when the minimum feels-like is below 8 °C, or when rain probability is at least 60 % and the minimum is below 15 °C

outerwear_allowed.text: outerwear is allowed when the minimum feels-like is below 18 °C, or for formal and evening occasions

outerwear_forbidden.text: outerwear is forbidden when the maximum feels-like is 24 °C or more, unless the piece is light (linen blazer, trench)

mid_layer_allowed.text: a mid layer is allowed only when the minimum feels-like is below 22 °C

base_layer_allowed_by_temperature.text: a base layer under a top is allowed when the minimum feels-like is below 12 °C, or when the top's layer_role is single or mid and the base has layer_role base; never with a one-piece

heavy_warmth_forbidden.text: heavy-warmth pieces (any slot) are forbidden when the maximum feels-like is above 15 °C

light_only_forbidden.text: an outfit made only of light-warmth pieces is forbidden when the minimum feels-like is below 8 °C

open_shoes_allowed.text: open shoes and sandals are allowed only when the minimum feels-like is 15 °C or more and rain probability is below 40 %
